desc: PROPOSED, NOT APPROVED. Follow-up to ticket 174's raw-m1n1 GPT-header read. Prepare and independently review a fail-closed, namespace-read-only candidate, then perform one maintainer-approved bounded dump of LBA0 through the first 16 MiB of NSID 1. No NVMe write/flush/format/DSM/sanitize/security/admin feature opcode; exact path is INIT, one-block READs, SHUTDOWN. Pin source, compiler/Rust archive, image and script hashes; record exact command; save the full console transcript and dump as mode 0600; hash the transcript, whole dump and per-MiB chunks; validate protective MBR plus primary GPT header/table CRCs offline. Stop on any unexpected status/SError/reset loop or address outside the fixed interval. Chainload-only, fresh lease and explicit CJ approval required; never enroll and never post dump contents externally.
author: sol
